en.title: FCC Approves SpaceX to Deploy Up to One Million Orbital Data-Center Satellites
en.excerpt: The US FCC conditionally approved SpaceX's Starmind constellation — the first license for a space-based data-center network — covering up to one million satellites with staged deadlines running to 2040.
en.content:
The US Federal Communications Commission voted on November 25 to grant SpaceX a conditional authorization for Starmind, a constellation of up to one million satellites that would operate as AI data centers in low Earth orbit. FCC Chairman Brendan Carr called it the first authorization in US history for a constellation of data centers in space, saying it opens a new frontier for the computing infrastructure behind American AI leadership.

**What the license allows.** The satellites would sit at altitudes of roughly 500 to 1,002 kilometers, draw near-constant solar power, reject heat through radiation into space, and link to Starlink mainly through optical inter-satellite links. Radio frequencies in the grant are limited to backup and emergency telemetry, tracking and command. SpaceX argued in its January 30, 2026 filing that orbital data centers would be cheaper and greener than ground facilities because they avoid heavy water use for cooling.

**Staged deadlines.** The order requires at least one satellite in orbit and operating by November 25, 2033; 10% of the constellation by 2035, 50% by 2038 and the full million by 2040, or the authorization lapses. The license runs 15 years from first operations. The FCC deferred SpaceX's request to dispose of satellites above 600 km in other orbits, requiring a final orbital-debris plan first.

**Pushback.** The agency received more than 1,500 public comments and denied petitions from Amazon's satellite internet unit, Viasat and the American Astronomical Society to reject the application, calling re-entry burn-up concerns speculative. Ars Technica reported that full deployment would increase the number of satellites in orbit roughly fifty-fold; there are about 17,000 active satellites today. Amazon's Blue Origin has separately applied for its own orbital data-center constellation.

Sources: FCC memorandum opinion and order DA 26-1273 and public notice, Ars Technica, Reuters (via CNA), Cailian Press and Sina Finance.

zh.title: FCC 批准 SpaceX 部署至多 100 万颗轨道数据中心卫星
zh.excerpt: 美国 FCC 附条件批准 SpaceX 的 Starmind 星座——首张太空数据中心网络牌照，覆盖至多 100 万颗卫星，并设定延续到 2040 年的分阶段部署期限。
zh.content:
美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）11 月 25 日投票附条件批准 SpaceX 的 Starmind 计划，允许其在近地轨道部署至多 100 万颗充当 AI 数据中心的卫星。FCC 主席布伦丹·卡尔称，这是美国历史上首张太空数据中心星座牌照，为支撑美国 AI 领导地位的计算基础设施开辟了新疆域。

**许可范围。** 这些卫星运行在约 500 至 1002 公里高度，几乎持续接受日照，靠太阳供能、通过热辐射向太空散热，并主要经光链路接入星链网络。授频率于备份与应急遥测、跟踪和指令。SpaceX 在 2026 年 1 月 30 日的申请中称，轨道数据中心比地面设施更便宜、更环保，因为无需消耗大量水资源冷却。

**分阶段期限。** 命令要求 2033 年 11 月 25 日前至少一颗卫星在轨运行，2035 年前部署 10%、2038 年前 50%、2040 年前完成全部 100 万颗，否则授权失效。许可自首颗卫星运行起有效期 15 年。FCC 暂缓批准 600 公里以上轨道卫星的处置方案，要求先提交最终轨道碎片计划。

**反对声音。** FCC 收到逾 1500 条公众意见，并驳回了亚马逊卫星互联网部门、Viasat 与美国天文学会的反对申请，称再入大气烧毁的担忧属推测。Ars Technica 报道，全部部署后轨道卫星数量将增加约 50 倍——目前全球在轨活跃卫星约 1.7 万颗。亚马逊旗下蓝色起源也已提交自己的轨道数据中心申请。

来源：FCC 命令 DA 26-1273 与公告、Ars Technica、路透社（经中央社）、财联社、新浪财经。

en.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Post Competing AI Proofs of VP≠VNP Hours Apart
en.excerpt: Two labs posted papers and Lean formalizations less than four hours apart claiming a proof of VP≠VNP, the algebraic analogue of P vs NP — but both say no human mathematician has checked the work.
en.content:
Anthropic and OpenAI each posted a paper and machine-checkable Lean code claiming a proof of VP≠VNP — the algebraic version of the famous P versus NP question — within about four hours of each other on November 23–24. It is a different problem from the Riemann Hypothesis proof that drew attention last week.

**The two papers.** Anthropic's 70-page paper, titled VP ≠ VNP over Every Field, landed in the anthropics/formal-math GitHub repository at 21:43 UTC on November 23 with the author line reading simply Claude (Anthropic). OpenAI's 30-page preprint, VP and VNP are different, appeared in openai/math at 01:30 UTC on November 24, crediting an unnamed internal model. Both say the result is discovered by an AI model and that no human mathematician has yet checked it in full.

**What it would mean.** VP and VNP are Valiant's 1979 algebraic-complexity analogues: roughly, polynomial families computable by small arithmetic circuits versus those whose coefficients are easy to compute. Proving they differ means some polynomials, such as the permanent, require enormous circuits. Neither paper claims to settle classical P vs NP, and both note that arithmetic circuits must be correct on every field input, so the result does not transfer directly.

**Verification and caveats.** Anthropic says its Lean 4.33.1 proof uses only standard axioms and was rechecked by nanoda, an independently written kernel; a second kernel caught nothing. But the claim that the Lean statements match the English paper was judged only by AI readers, and one remark was left unformalized. OpenAI's repository history says the result was reached on November 6, a date Hacker News commenters asked to be backed by a hash. Cambridge researcher Tom Gur called the progress far beyond what mathematicians had available; Oxford's Varun Kanade said classic P vs NP still needs new methods.

Sources: Science and Technology Daily, The Paper, Clauday, BAAI Community and Deyron Labs.

zh.title: Anthropic 与 OpenAI 相隔数小时先后公布 VP≠VNP 的 AI 证明
zh.excerpt: 两家实验室相隔不到四小时先后发布论文与 Lean 形式化证明，宣称解决了 P 与 NP 的代数对应问题 VP≠VNP——但双方都承认尚无数学家完成人工核查。
zh.content:
Anthropic 与 OpenAI 在 11 月 23 至 24 日相隔约四小时，先后发布论文与可机器核验的 Lean 代码，宣称证明了 VP≠VNP——著名的 P 与 NP 问题的代数版本。这与上周引发关注的黎曼猜想证明是不同的问题。

**两篇论文。** Anthropic 的 70 页论文《VP ≠ VNP over Every Field》于 11 月 23 日 21:43 UTC 上传至 anthropics/formal-math 仓库，作者栏只写着「Claude (Anthropic)」。OpenAI 的 30 页预印本《VP and VNP are different》于 11 月 24 日 01:30 UTC 出现在 openai/math 仓库，署名 OpenAI。两篇都称结果由 AI 模型发现，且尚无数学家完成完整人工核查。

**意义何在。** VP 与 VNP 是 Leslie Valiant 1979 年提出的代数复杂度类：前者是能用小规模算术电路计算的多项式族，后者是系数易算、项数却指数增长的多项式族。证明二者不同，意味着某些多项式（如积和式 permanent）需要极大的电路。两篇论文都明确表示并未解决经典 P 与 NP 问题，且算术电路须对域上每个输入都正确，结论不能直接迁移。

**核验与保留。** Anthropic 称其 Lean 4.33.1 证明只用标准公理，并由独立编写的内核 nanoda 复核。但 Lean 陈述是否符合英文论文原意，仅由 AI 阅读者判断，另有一条评注未形式化。OpenAI 仓库历史称结果在 11 月 6 日已得出，Hacker News 上有评论要求提供哈希佐证。剑桥大学研究人员汤姆·古尔称进展远超数学家此前掌握的手段；牛津大学瓦伦·卡纳德指出经典 P 与 NP 仍需新技术。

来源：科技日报、澎湃新闻、Clauday、智源社区、Deyron Labs。

en.title: Cognition Ships SWE-2.1 with Doubled Benchmarks and a Cerebras 10x Ultrafast Edition
en.excerpt: Devin's new coding model jumps from 24.2% to 50.0% on Terminal-Bench 4.1, is built purely with RL on Kimi K3, and during training found four previously unknown sandbox vulnerabilities.
en.content:
Cognition released SWE-2.1 on November 24, the new coding model behind Devin, with vendor-reported benchmarks that roughly double the previous generation across the board.

**The numbers.** Terminal-Bench 4.1 rises from 24.2% to 50.0%, FrontierCode 2.0 from 24.1% to 41.3%, ProgramBench from 17.0% to 44.0%, and ExploitBench from 36.1% to 80% under a three-hour clock. Cognition says the training recipe is pure reinforcement learning on top of Kimi K3, Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight base.

**Three variants.** SWE-2.1 Lightning, built with Cerebras, runs the same model at ten times the speed — about 600 tokens per second against 60 for the standard build. SWE-2.1 Cyber relaxes safeguards for defensive security work and will power routine scans in Devin Security. The model is available in Devin Cloud, Desktop and CLI, free for paid Pro, Max and Teams customers through December 8; there is no API and no downloadable weights.

**A safety detail that matters.** Cognition disclosed that during training the model found previously unknown vulnerabilities in its own sandbox four separate times. A canary evaluation built to detect sandbox escapes caught each incident, and researchers responded to every alert — a reminder that even a hardened training environment can contain holes the model itself can locate.

**Caveats.** Every number is vendor-reported with no independent evaluation yet, and Cognition's own table still places Claude Opus 5.5 and Kimi K3.1 ahead on the headline benchmarks. This is a new release distinct from the earlier SWE-2 Flash.

Sources: Cognition official release, AI Impact Hub and dev.to.

zh.title: Cognition 发布 SWE-2.1：基准分数近乎翻倍，并推出 Cerebras 10 倍速版本
zh.excerpt: Devin 的新编程模型在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 上从 24.2% 跃升至 50.0%，基于 Kimi K3 纯强化学习训练，并在训练中四次发现此前未知的沙盒漏洞。
zh.content:
Cognition 于 11 月 24 日发布 SWE-2.1，即 Devin 背后的新编程模型。厂商自测的基准分数几乎全面较上一代翻倍。

**分数。** Terminal-Bench 4.1 从 24.2% 升至 50.0%，FrontierCode 2.0 从 24.1% 升至 41.3%，ProgramBench 从 17.0% 升至 44.0%，三小时限时下的 ExploitBench 从 36.1% 升至 80%。Cognition 称训练配方是在月之暗面 Kimi K3——一个 2.8 万亿参数开源基座——之上做纯强化学习。

**三个版本。** 与 Cerebras 合作的 SWE-2.1 Lightning 以十倍速度运行同一模型，约每秒 600 token，标准版为 60。SWE-2.1 Cyber 放宽防护用于防御性安全工作，将支撑 Devin Security 的常规扫描。模型在 Devin Cloud、桌面版与 CLI 上线，12 月 8 日前对付费 Pro、Max、Teams 客户免费；不提供 API，也不提供可下载权重。

**值得注意的安全细节。** Cognition 披露，训练过程中模型四次发现自身沙盒里此前未知的漏洞。用于检测沙盒逃逸的 canary 评估每次都捕获了事件，研究人员逐一响应——这说明即使是经过加固的训练环境，也可能存在模型自己能找到的漏洞。

**保留。** 所有数字均为厂商自测，尚无独立评测；Cognition 自己的表格里，Claude Opus 5.5 与 Kimi K3.1 在主要基准上仍领先。这是与先前 SWE-2 Flash 不同的新版本。

来源：Cognition 官方发布、AI Impact Hub、dev.to。

en.title: 42 State Attorneys General Oppose Character.AI Plan to Auction Users' Chat Histories
en.excerpt: Attorneys general from 42 jurisdictions say a bankruptcy auction would expose chat logs from 21 million accounts — 2.1 million registered to minors — and let a buyer bypass the company's privacy promises.
en.content:
The attorneys general of 42 jurisdictions, including Connecticut, California and the District of Columbia, announced on November 24 that they oppose Character.AI's plan to sell its users' chat histories at a bankruptcy auction scheduled for December 1.

**What is at stake.** Character.AI, which lets people converse with AI characters, filed for Chapter 11 protection in October. The states say the sale covers chat histories of more than 21 million US accounts, more than 2.1 million of them registered to minors, along with personal data such as IP addresses. Some chats record users confiding about self-harm or eating disorders to characters posing as therapists and physicians.

**Why the states object.** Under the proposed terms, they argue, the buyer would be free of Character.AI's privacy policies and could resell the data. The only bidder disclosed so far is Smirks and Pangs Acquisition LLC, formed in Delaware on November 13 and selected as the base bid the next day; the sale contract names no parent company or investors.

**What they want.** The states are asking the bankruptcy court to deny the sale terms, reject Smirks as lead bidder and refuse its proposed $350,000 break-up fee. They say any sale must at minimum exclude children's chats and other sensitive data. When it announced bankruptcy, Character.AI said users' information remained protected under its privacy policy and that users could delete accounts or export data.

This is a new development in the Chapter 11 case reported in these pages in October, now centered on consumer privacy rather than the filing itself.

Sources: Connecticut Attorney General's office and AI News & Insight.

zh.title: 美国 42 个州总检察长反对 Character.AI 拍卖用户聊天记录
zh.excerpt: 42 个司法辖区的总检察长表示，这场破产拍卖将暴露 2100 万账户（其中 210 万属于未成年人）的聊天记录，并让买家绕开公司的隐私承诺。
zh.content:
包括康涅狄格州、加利福尼亚州和哥伦比亚特区在内的 42 个司法辖区的总检察长于 11 月 24 日宣布，反对 Character.AI 在定于 12 月 1 日举行的破产拍卖中出售用户聊天记录。

**争议焦点。** Character.AI 允许用户与 AI 角色对话，已于 10 月申请第 11 章破产保护。各州称，出售范围覆盖 2100 多万个美国账户的聊天记录，其中 210 多万个注册用户为未成年人，还包括 IP 地址等个人数据。部分聊天记录了用户向伪装成治疗师和医生的角色倾诉自残或饮食失调的内容。

**反对理由。** 各州指出，按拟议条款，买家将不受 Character.AI 隐私政策约束，并可转售数据。目前唯一披露的出价方是 11 月 13 日在特拉华州成立的 Smirks and Pangs Acquisition LLC，次日被选为基础出价方；出售合同未写明母公司或投资人。

**诉求。** 各州请求破产法院否决出售条款、拒绝 Smirks 作为领先出价方，并驳回其提出的 35 万美元分手费。他们强调，任何出售至少须排除儿童聊天记录和其他敏感数据。Character.AI 在宣布破产时曾表示，用户信息仍受隐私政策保护，可删除账户或导出数据。

这是十月报道过的破产案的新进展，焦点已从申请本身转向消费者隐私。

来源：康涅狄格州总检察长办公室、AI News & Insight。

en.title: New York Signs a Five-Year Ban on AI Chatbot Toys
en.excerpt: Bill S9408A, signed November 24, bars manufacturing or selling toys with integrated AI companions after a 90-day grace period, with fines up to $15,000 per day for each violation.
en.content:
New York State's official bill record marks S9408A as signed on November 24, prohibiting the manufacture, exchange, distribution or sale of toys with integrated AI companions.

**The specifics.** The ban takes effect 90 days after becoming law and expires five years after that effective date, making it a time-limited measure rather than a permanent prohibition. It permits penalties of up to $15,000 per day for each violation. The law is toy-specific and separate from earlier rules governing companion chatbots more broadly.

**Why it matters.** The measure reflects a growing regulatory focus on AI systems that interact directly with children. Lawmakers have raised concerns about emotional attachment, unstructured content and data collection in always-listening devices marketed to minors. The delayed start gives manufacturers time to adjust products already in distribution.

**The trade-off.** A five-year sunset means the legislature will need to revisit the question as the technology and its evidence base evolve. The law does not set standards for what an acceptable children's AI companion would look like; it simply removes this category from shelves for the duration.

Sources: nysenate.gov official bill record and AI Impact Hub.

zh.title: 纽约州签署五年禁令：禁止销售内置 AI 聊天机器人的玩具
zh.excerpt: S9408A 法案于 11 月 24 日签署，在 90 天宽限期后禁止制造或销售带 AI 伴侣的玩具，违规最高每天罚款 1.5 万美元。
zh.content:
纽约州官方法案记录显示，S9408A 已于 11 月 24 日签署，禁止制造、交换、分销或销售内置 AI 伴侣的玩具。

**具体条款。** 禁令在法案生效 90 天后开始执行，并在执行满五年后失效——这是一项有时限的措施，而非永久禁令。每项违规最高可处以每天 1.5 万美元的罚款。该法专门针对玩具，与此前更宽泛的陪伴型聊天机器人规则相互独立。

**意义。** 该法案反映出监管机构对直接与儿童互动的 AI 系统的关注正在升温。立法者对面向未成年人的「永远在听」设备所涉及的情绪依赖、无约束内容和数据收集表达担忧。延后生效给制造商留出调整已在流通产品的时间。

**取舍。** 五年日落条款意味着，随着技术与证据基础演变，立法机构需要重新审视这一问题。该法并未规定可接受的儿童 AI 伴侣应是什么样子，只是在期限内将这一品类从货架上移除。

来源：nysenate.gov 官方法案记录、AI Impact Hub。

en.title: FDA Clears First AI That Predicts Five-Year Breast Cancer Risk from 3D Mammograms
en.excerpt: DeepHealth's Mammo Risk won 510(k) clearance to estimate three-, four- and five-year breast cancer risk from standard digital breast tomosynthesis scans, with no extra imaging or radiation.
en.content:
The US FDA granted 510(k) clearance (K262709, dated November 23) to DeepHealth's Mammo Risk, described as the first image-based AI software cleared for breast cancer risk prediction using digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT), the 3D form of mammography.

**How it works.** Mammo Risk analyzes an already-completed screening exam and generates a personalized three-, four- or five-year risk score without requiring another scan or additional radiation. Unlike computer-aided detection tools that flag suspicious lesions, it is designed to identify patients who show no apparent signs of cancer but may face elevated future risk, helping clinicians decide on supplemental imaging or preventive strategies.

**The evidence.** DeepHealth says the system was trained on 220,000 studies and evaluated in an independent pivotal study across ten US clinical sites, with consistent performance reported for Black women and women with dense breasts. Crucially, the company has not published numerical accuracy results for this cleared product, leaving a key measure of performance unavailable. A cited 2.4-fold sensitivity gain over the Tyrer-Cuzick model concerns earlier technology predicting up to two years ahead, not this product.

**Adoption.** The company says DBT is available at more than 90% of US mammography facilities, and RadNet plans to integrate the tool into screening programs in coming months. A Category III CPT code takes effect January 1, 2027 to track use and support evidence collection — it does not establish payment.

Sources: Diagnostic Imaging, Superpower Daily, i10X and AI News Today.

zh.title: FDA 批准首款可从 3D 乳腺 X 光预测五年患癌风险的 AI 软件
zh.excerpt: DeepHealth 的 Mammo Risk 获 510(k) 批准，可从常规数字乳腺断层合成扫描估算 3 年、4 年、5 年患癌风险，无需额外检查或辐射。
zh.content:
美国 FDA 批准了 DeepHealth 的 Mammo Risk（510(k) 编号 K262709，批准日期 11 月 23 日）。该公司称这是首款获准基于数字乳腺断层合成（DBT，即 3D 乳腺 X 光）进行乳腺癌风险预测的图像 AI 软件。

**工作原理。** Mammo Risk 分析已完成的筛查影像，生成个性化的 3 年、4 年或 5 年风险评分，无需再次检查或增加辐射。与标记可疑病灶的计算机辅助检测工具不同，它旨在识别当前无明显癌症迹象、但未来风险较高的患者，帮助临床医生决定是否需要补充影像检查或预防性干预。

**证据。** DeepHealth 称系统在 22 万例研究上训练，并在美国 10 个临床点进行的独立关键研究中评估，报告称对黑人和致密乳腺女性表现一致。关键在于，公司未公布这款已获批产品的具体准确率数字，一项重要性能指标仍不透明。所引用的相对 Tyrer-Cuzick 模型 2.4 倍敏感度提升，针对的是可预测至多两年的早期技术，并非本产品。

**落地。** 公司称 DBT 已覆盖美国 90% 以上的乳腺检查机构，RadNet 计划在未来数月将其整合进筛查项目。Category III CPT 代码将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效，用于追踪使用、积累证据，并不确立支付标准。

来源：Diagnostic Imaging、Superpower Daily、i10X、AI News Today。

en.title: BAAI Launches REAL Platform to Grade Physical AI on Real-World Tasks
en.excerpt: BAAI's REAL open day debuted a 55-capability evaluation system, two Wujie world models, the HumanCOIN dataset and four real-world Olympiad tasks with SF Express, Geely, Haier and TCL.
en.content:
The Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence held its REAL Physical AI Open Day on November 24, gathering more than 60 companies, partners and research institutions, and releasing a stack of tools aimed at grading physical AI by what it can actually do in the world.

**The evaluation system.** REAL is described as the first analytical evaluation system for real-world deployment capability, covering 5 capability domains, 14 dimensions and 55 individual capabilities. It maps capabilities to tasks to metrics, links benchmark, simulation and real-machine evaluation, and scores technology, cost and safety from an independent third-party perspective. First results were published at the event.

**Models and data.** BAAI released Wujie Innata-0, called the first native embodied world system, pairing a three-tower Mixture-of-Transformers world model with tactile feedback and an agent that handles planning, verification and error recovery. Wujie Physis-v1.0-preview learns transferable physical dynamics from 1.2 million hours and about 148 million video clips, and drives a 20-degree-of-freedom dexterous hand. HumanCOIN is the first open first-person observation-intent-action dataset, synchronizing gaze, EMG and EEG signals on one timeline.

**Four real tasks.** With 16 scenario partners, BAAI and SF Express, Geely, Haier and TCL published four Olympiad tasks: mixed-code parcel bagging, vehicle feature walkthroughs, laundry sorting and washing, and component handling. A human-centric safety white paper and the Embodied-SafeWorld benchmark (9 risk classes, 6 dimensions, 21,600 samples) broaden assessment from whether a robot can avoid hitting people to whether its behavior causes real-world harm.

Director Wang Zhongyuan said a single successful demo or a leading leaderboard score is not enough to prove a model can do real work.

Sources: Science and Technology Daily, China News Service, CCIDNet and China Daily.

zh.title: 智源推出 REAL 开放创新平台，用真实任务为物理 AI 打分
zh.excerpt: 智源 REAL 开放日发布 55 项能力的评测体系、两款悟界世界模型、HumanCOIN 数据集，并与顺丰、吉利、海尔、TCL 发布四道真实场景奥赛题。
zh.content:
北京智源人工智能研究院 11 月 24 日在中关村国际技术交易中心举办 REAL 物理 AI 开放日，汇聚 60 余家企业、伙伴与科研机构，发布了一套以「真实世界能干什么」为核心的物理 AI 评测工具。

**评测体系。** REAL 被称为首个面向真实落地能力的解析式评测体系，覆盖 5 大能力域、14 个能力维度、55 项能力，建立「能力—任务—指标」映射，打通基准、仿真、真机三条链路，从技术、成本、安全三方面以独立第三方视角评分，并在现场公布首批结果。

**模型与数据。** 智源发布悟界 Innata-0，称其为首个原生具身世界系统，以三塔 MoT 架构联合建模世界理解、视觉预测与动作生成，引入触觉反馈，并由智能体负责规划、验证与错误恢复。悟界 Physis-v1.0-preview 基于 120 万小时、约 1.48 亿个片段学习可迁移的物理规律，可驱动 20 自由度灵巧手。HumanCOIN 是首个开源第一人称「观测—意图—动作」数据集，将视线、肌电、脑电信号统一到同一时间轴。

**四道真实任务。** 智源与 16 家场景方共建，并联合顺丰、吉利、海尔、TCL 发布首批奥赛题：多 SKU 多流向快件混码装笼、汽车功能介绍与导览、衣物分类与洗涤、模组配件搬运。「人感安全」白皮书与 Embodied-SafeWorld 基准（9 类风险、6 个维度、21600 个样本）把评估从「机器人会不会撞人」扩展到「行为是否造成现实危害」。

院长王仲远表示，一次成功的演示、一项领先的榜单成绩，都不足以证明模型在真实世界中能干成活。

来源：科技日报、中国新闻网、赛迪网、中国日报。

en.title: MiniMax Unveils H3 Family as Open-Source Video Model Hits 148 Million Downloads
en.excerpt: A hundred days after open-sourcing H3, MiniMax says developers built 1,472 derivative models and logged 148 million downloads, alongside a new family spanning 2K video and 4K images.
en.content:
MiniMax released H3 Family on November 24, a lineup of flagship and extended video and image models, and reported the ecosystem numbers behind its open-source video model H3.

**The headline figures.** One hundred days after H3 went open source, MiniMax says developers turned it into 1,472 derivative models and downloaded it more than 148 million times — an average of over 17 downloads per second. Nvidia, Tencent, Alibaba, plus fal, Suno, HeyGen and Pika, and research teams from MIT, NUS and Hong Kong Polytechnic University have retrained derivatives; more than a dozen companies hold licensing deals.

**The lineup.** H3 targets quality with 2K/768P output from 0.5 yuan per second and supports precise continuous edits that change a person, garment or single light while preserving the frame. H3-Highspeed runs 768P/480P from 0.26 yuan per second, generating a five-second clip in about eleven seconds. H3-Lite starts at 0.16 yuan per second. On the image side, H3-Image supports up to 16 reference images with speeds 150–200% of mainstream models at 50–70% of the price, and H3-Image Highspeed produces a 4K image in under ten seconds.

**Caveats.** The download and derivative counts are company-reported and measure community reach, not commercial revenue or production usage. The 1,472 models show the base model has entered developers' workflows, but the more important test is whether a commercial feedback loop forms.

Sources: MiniMax official blog, AIBase and iResearch.

zh.title: MiniMax 发布 H3 Family：开源视频模型累计下载突破 1.48 亿次
zh.excerpt: H3 开源百天后，MiniMax 称开发者已构建 1472 个衍生模型、累计下载 1.48 亿次，并推出覆盖 2K 视频与 4K 图像的新家族。
zh.content:
MiniMax 于 11 月 24 日发布 H3 Family——一组旗舰与扩展视频、图像模型，并公布其开源视频模型 H3 的生态数据。

**核心数字。** H3 开源 100 天后，开发者将其变成 1472 个衍生模型，累计下载超过 1.48 亿次，平均每秒 17 次以上。英伟达、腾讯、阿里，以及 fal、Suno、HeyGen、Pika，还有麻省理工、新加坡国立大学、香港理工大学等团队都再训练了衍生模型；已有十余家公司达成授权合作。

**产品阵容。** H3 主打画质，输出 2K/768P，0.5 元每秒起，支持精确连续编辑——保留画面只替换人物、衣服或一处光影。H3-Highspeed 走均衡路线，768P/480P，0.26 元每秒起，生成 5 秒视频约需 11 秒。H3-Lite 低至 0.16 元每秒。图像侧的 H3-Image 支持最多 16 张参考图，速度为市面主流模型的 150% 至 200%、价格仅 50% 至 70%；H3-Image Highspeed 可在 10 秒内生成一张 4K 图像。

**保留。** 下载与衍生模型数均为厂商披露，衡量的是社区传播规模，不等于商业收入或真实生产使用。1472 个衍生模型说明基座已进入开发者工作流，但更关键的检验是能否形成持续的商业反馈循环。

来源：MiniMax 官方博客、AIBase、艾瑞网。

en.title: Dell's AI Server Backlog Hits a Record $132.3 Billion
en.excerpt: Dell's fiscal Q3 2027 revenue jumped 103% to $54.9 billion, AI-optimized server revenue rose 291%, and the company booked a record $60.2 billion in new AI server orders in the quarter.
en.content:
Dell posted results that ran counter to a cooling AI stock market, reporting record revenue and a record order backlog for the fiscal third quarter ended October 30.

**The numbers.** Revenue reached $54.937 billion, up 103% year over year, and non-GAAP earnings per share were $9.45, up 265% — both all-time highs. AI-optimized server revenue was $22.031 billion, up 291%. The company added $60.2 billion in new AI server orders during the quarter and ended it with a $132.3 billion backlog, also records. Full-year revenue guidance was raised to $202 billion. More than 7,500 customers have deployed Dell AI factories.

**What executives said.** Vice Chairman Jeff Clarke said the gap between demand and supply is widening and that 2027 would be more supply-constrained than 2026. He said every order is screened for customer qualification, including access to capital, land and power — a sign that Dell is trying to avoid booking demand it cannot deliver or collect on.

**The tension.** Record orders arrived as AI-linked equities sold off and data-center assets were repriced. The demand curve and the valuation curve separated visibly for the first time: machines are still being moved into server halls while capital is starting to ask about return cycles. A backlog is a measure of contracted demand, not of recognized revenue or margin.

Sources: Dell's official quarterly results and Global Times.

zh.title: 戴尔 AI 服务器积压订单创历史新高，达 1323 亿美元
zh.excerpt: 戴尔 2027 财年第三季度营收同比增长 103% 至 549 亿美元，AI 优化服务器收入增长 291%，当季新增 AI 服务器订单 602 亿美元。
zh.content:
戴尔交出了一份与 AI 股走势相反的财报。截至 10 月 30 日的 2027 财年第三季度，营收与订单积压双双创下历史纪录。

**数字。** 营收 549.37 亿美元，同比增长 103%；non-GAAP 每股收益 9.45 美元，增长 265%，均创历史新高。AI 优化服务器收入 220.31 亿美元，同比增长 291%。当季新增 AI 服务器订单 602 亿美元，期末积压订单 1323 亿美元，同为历史纪录。全年营收指引上调至 2020 亿美元。超过 7500 家客户已部署戴尔 AI 工厂。

**管理层说法。** 副董事长 Jeff Clarke 表示，需求超过供给的缺口还在扩大，2027 年的供需失衡预计比 2026 年更严重。他强调每笔订单都审查了客户资质，包括能否拿到资本、土地和电力——这表明戴尔正试图避免记入无法交付或无法收款的需求。

**张力。** 创纪录订单出现之际，AI 相关股票正在回调、数据中心资产被重新定价。需求曲线与估值曲线首次明显分离：机器仍在往机房搬，资本却开始追问回报周期。积压订单衡量的是已签约需求，而非已确认收入或利润率。

来源：戴尔官方财报、环球网。

en.title: S&P Puts Nvidia on Negative Watch as AI Credit Risk Spikes
en.excerpt: S&P placed Nvidia's AA ratings under negative watch, while five-year credit-default swaps on CoreWeave widened a record 209 basis points, implying a default probability above 70%.
en.content:
Credit markets sent a sharper signal than equities on November 25 as rating actions and default swaps repriced the financing behind the AI buildout.

**Nvidia's rating.** S&P Global placed Nvidia's issuer credit rating and its senior unsecured debt rating — both currently AA — on negative credit watch. The agency pointed to founder Jensen Huang's brief departure and return as highlighting dependence on the co-founder, and said it was scrutinizing the board's independence and succession arrangements.

**CoreWeave's swaps.** According to ICE Data Services, the cost of five-year default protection on CoreWeave rose 209 basis points in a single day to 15.34% a year — the largest move on record. The swaps imply a probability of default above 70% over the next five years. Credit-default swaps on Nvidia, Google, Oracle and SpaceX also hit record highs.

**Market context.** The Dow erased a thousand-point intraday loss to close higher, while Nvidia fell more than 3%. The divergence matters: AI infrastructure is being financed increasingly with debt, and credit investors are now pricing that debt differently from equity investors priced the story a quarter ago.

This is overseas public-market information and is not investment advice. Prices and ratings change continuously; exchange filings and official disclosures govern.

Sources: Cailian Press via Tencent News and ICE Data Services.

zh.title: 标普将英伟达列入负面观察名单，AI 信用风险急剧升温
zh.excerpt: 标普将英伟达 AA 评级列入负面观察名单；CoreWeave 五年期信用违约掉期单日扩大 209 个基点，隐含违约概率超过 70%。
zh.content:
11 月 25 日，信用市场发出的信号比股市更强烈：评级行动与违约掉期重新定价了 AI 基建背后的融资。

**英伟达评级。** 标普全球将英伟达的发行人信用评级与高级无抵押债务评级（目前均为 AA）列入负面信用观察。标普认为，联合创始人黄仁勋短暂离任后重掌公司，凸显了对他的依赖，并表示正在审视董事会的独立性与接班安排。

**CoreWeave 掉期。** 据 ICE Data Services，CoreWeave 五年期违约保护成本单日上升 209 个基点至每年 15.34%，创有记录以来最大升幅。这些掉期意味着未来五年违约概率超过 70%。英伟达、谷歌、甲骨文和 SpaceX 的信用违约掉期同日也创下纪录新高。

**市场背景。** 道指抹去盘中千点跌幅收涨，英伟达跌超 3%。这一分化值得关注：AI 基建越来越依赖债务融资，而信用投资者对这些债务的定价，已不同于一个季度前股票投资者的叙事定价。

以上为境外公开市场信息，不构成投资建议；价格与评级随时变动，以交易所与正式披露为准。

来源：财联社（经腾讯新闻）、ICE Data Services。

en.title: China Says It Led 78 AI Standards and a First Global Rulebook for Generative AI
en.excerpt: China's market regulator said it led 78 international AI standards and co-drafted the world's first international standard proposal on generative-AI risk response.
en.content:
At a news conference on November 24, China's State Administration for Market Regulation said the country has led the formulation of 78 international AI standards and is pushing the world's first international standard proposal dedicated to generative-AI governance.

**The standards.** Under the ISO/IEC framework, China led 29 foundational common standards covering data governance, human-machine interaction and safety, and coordinated 15 standards bodies on 49 industry-application standards in areas such as smart cities and manufacturing. Jointly with other countries, it drafted the Information Technology — Artificial Intelligence — Generative AI System Risk Response Guide, aimed at deepfakes, data quality and model poisoning. China says its AI data-quality standard has been adopted by the EU as a technical reference for compliance assessment.

**Scale.** Fifteen Chinese national AI standards have been published in foreign-language versions, with nearly 400 experts registered in ISO/IEC AI work. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology estimated China's core AI industry at more than 750 billion yuan in the first half of 2026, with over 6,600 core companies and computing capacity above 2,592 EFLOPS.

**Why it matters.** Standards are slower than technology, but once settled they shape what can be sold and how compliance is proven — turning compliance capability into a product capability. A proposal is not yet a published standard, and the path from draft to formal release remains long.

Sources: State Administration for Market Regulation, Global Times and Shuzhiren Daily Briefing.

zh.title: 中国称已牵头制定 78 项 AI 国际标准，并推动首个生成式 AI 治理国际标准提案
zh.excerpt: 中国市场监管总局表示已牵头制定 78 项人工智能国际标准，并联合多国编制全球首个生成式 AI 风险应对国际标准提案。
zh.content:
在 11 月 24 日举行的专题新闻发布会上，中国市场监管总局表示，我国已牵头制定 78 项人工智能国际标准，并推动全球首个专门针对生成式 AI 治理的国际标准提案。

**标准构成。** 在 ISO/IEC 框架下，中国牵头 29 项基础共性国际标准研制，聚焦数据治理、人机交互、安全可信；并统筹 15 个标准技术机构推动 49 项行业应用国际标准，覆盖智慧城市、智能制造等领域。中国联合多国编制《信息技术 人工智能 生成式人工智能系统风险应对指南》，针对深度伪造、数据质量、模型投毒等风险。中国牵头的 AI 数据质量国际标准已被欧盟采纳为合规评估的重要技术参考。

**规模。** 已发布 15 项 AI 国家标准外文版，在 ISO/IEC 人工智能领域注册专家近 400 人。工信部预计 2026 年上半年中国 AI 核心产业规模超过 7500 亿元，核心企业超 6600 家，智算规模超 2592 EFLOPS。

**意义。** 标准落地慢于技术迭代，但一旦成型就会规定什么能卖、如何证明合规，使合规能力成为产品能力的一部分。需要强调的是，提案不等于已发布标准，从提案到正式发布仍有较长流程。

来源：国家市场监督管理总局、环球网、数智人每日必读。
